ABOUT VEIL

Useful context.
Less sensitive detail.

Veil checks text for email addresses, Singapore-format phone and identity numbers, monetary values, and names introduced by labels such as “Prepared by” or “Employee”. Add your own terms for everything else.

Review on your device. Document content is processed in browser memory. It is not sent to an AI service or saved in browser storage. Refreshing clears your work.

A new copy, not a modified original. Downloads contain edited text only. Original files, images, comments and metadata are not included. PDF and DOCX formatting is not preserved. Scanned PDFs and images are not supported.

You remain the reviewer. Patterns can miss details or suggest harmless content. Replacements do not guarantee anonymity. Veil does not change document classification or authorise release.
